notes: Macros: '＋ New macro' makes an empty macro - recording only starts when you press ● Record in it (● Record more adds to the end)
Macros: ⧉ copies a step; paste it into any macro with ＋ → Paste (or 'Paste at the start', which also works in an empty macro)
Macros: new 'Camera move (degrees)' step - turn left/right and look up/down by an angle, over a set time. Set 'Mouse counts for a full turn' once with Test 360°
